description: This Java class 'CoreEvents' handles web application events related to scheduling services, running services, and file streaming within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for event placeholders, service scheduling, executing services, and streaming files, with internal logic for permission checks, parameter handling, and error management.

classes.name: CoreEvents
classes.description: Main class providing static methods for handling web events such as service scheduling, execution, and file streaming within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: returnSuccess
methods.description: Returns a success string as a placeholder event response.

methods.name: returnError
methods.description: Returns an error string as a placeholder event response.

methods.name: returnNull
methods.description: Returns null as a placeholder event response.

methods.name: scheduleService
methods.description: Schedules a service to run at a specific time or recurrence, handling parameters, permissions, and error checking.

methods.name: saveServiceResultsToSession
methods.description: Saves results from a synchronized service call into the session for later retrieval.

methods.name: getObjectFromServicePath
methods.description: Retrieves nested objects from service results based on a service path, handling maps, entities, and collections.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Executes a specified service with security and permission checks, supporting synchronous and asynchronous modes.

methods.name: streamFile
methods.description: Streams a file to the browser based on the request path.
